management.claim: Revenue grew 24% year on year and Google Cloud growth accelerated to 82%.
management.quote: Q2 was an amazing quarter, with Alphabet revenues growing 24% year-over-year and Google Cloud revenues accelerating to 82% growth, driven by demand for AI infrastructure and AI solutions.

management.claim: Other income was a net gain of $98.0 billion, mainly from unrealised gains on equity securities.
management.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls the quarter amazing and the results outstanding; the release states no headwind.

guidance.text: For the third quarter of 2026, Amazon expects net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion.
guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025.

management.claim: AWS grew 36.7% year on year, its fastest growth in 18 quarters.
management.quote: AWS is booming, growing 36.7% year-over-year in Q2—our fastest growth in 18 quarters

management.claim: Operating income rose to $27.5 billion from $19.2 billion a year earlier.

management.claim: Net income included $53.4 billion of non-operating other income, mainly from Anthropic investments.

tone.label: positive

guidance.text: Meta expects fourth quarter 2026 total revenue of $73-76 billion.

management.claim: The CEO says investments are paying off and the core business is strong.
management.quote: Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board.

management.claim: Costs and expenses include a $9.89 billion charge from the agreement with state attorneys general.
management.quote: Third quarter 2026 costs and expenses includes a $9.89 billion charge related to this agreement.

management.claim: Meta raised its 2026 total expense outlook to $175-179 billion.

tone.label: balanced

management.claim: Management says most underwriting businesses grew in the quarter despite a more competitive commercial market.

management.claim: The CEO is confident of strong growth in operating earnings and EPS.

tone.label: positive
